query:
WITH moved_labels AS (
            UPDATE eval.labels SET split = 'holdout'
             WHERE operator_turn_id = ANY($1) AND split = 'dev'
            RETURNING id
        )
        UPDATE eval.turn_splits
           SET split = 'holdout', split_reason = 'holdout_resplit_unused_dev', assigned_at = now()
         WHERE operator_turn_id = ANY($1) AND split = 'dev'
